title: Two component sheets assign a font stack to font-weight
foundBy: two independent reviewer agents, in separate batches, both reading the component stylesheets

evidence.verified: The new integrity check names both lines when run against the sheets as they stood one commit earlier: `dropdown.css:91` and `input.css:102`, exit 1. It passes on the corrected tree. The corrected declarations change 0 of 94 captures in visual:compare, which is what shows `font-family: var(--font-family-sans)` matches the family `reset.css` was already supplying through `font-family: inherit`. `npm run ci` exits 0 with every gate run and 628 tests.

details:
`src/styles/components/input.css:102` and `src/styles/components/dropdown.css:91` both declare `font-weight: var(--font-family-sans)`. A font stack is not a valid `font-weight`, so a browser drops the declaration.

Neither sheet sets `font-family` anywhere else. The rendered result still matches `components/Input.md:96` and `components/Dropdown.md:98`, because `src/styles/reset.css:97` gives form controls `font-family: inherit`.

Nothing looks wrong today. The rule written to assert the family is dead, and a change to the reset would take the family with it silently.

notes.text: Session agent confirmed every citation in this record against the tree at a374f2c before filing it.

Fixed rather than deleted, so the sheet asserts the family it documents. A change to the reset would otherwise have taken the family with it silently, which was the reason this was worth more than a tidy-up. The guard fails a font-family token on any property but `font-family` and the `font` shorthand, so the class of typo cannot return anywhere under src/styles/.
